title.purpose: Names plans, panels, objects, and the product inside the editor shell.

body.purpose: Carries control labels and explanatory interface copy.

label.purpose: Marks compact sections and toolbar fields.

measurement.purpose: Aligns dimensions, counts, zoom, and grid values for rapid comparison.

shadows.name: brand-mark
shadows.purpose: Anchors the blue brand mark inside the navy rail.

shadows.name: canvas-control
shadows.purpose: Separates persistent command clusters from the gridded canvas.

shadows.name: inline-editor
shadows.purpose: Lifts temporary value editors above their parent controls.

shadows.name: selection-toolbar
shadows.purpose: Marks the contextual object toolbar as the highest editor control layer.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Keeps color and shell-state changes quick and functional.

motion.name: mobile-sheet
motion.purpose: Moves the left-side object and navigation sheet without theatrical motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The affirmative editor action, reserved for clear forward progress.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: oklch(0.49 0.19 257); color: #fff; font: 500 14px/1.4 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.44 0.19 257); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.58 0.17 257); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.17 257 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Command Button
components.description: A quiet default for grouped toolbar and header commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.22 0.045 255); font: 500 14px/1.4 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.95 0.018 250); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.58 0.17 257); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.17 257 / 0.5); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: A restrained danger treatment for clear, high-risk editor actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.1); color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); font: 500 14px/1.4 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-destructive svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.4); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); } .ds-btn-destructive:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The object-library search field with a solid drafting surface and explicit focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="m20 20-3.5-3.5"/></svg><input aria-label="Search object library" placeholder="Search library"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; width: 240px; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; transform: translateY(-50%); fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 10px 0 36px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: oklch(0.22 0.045 255); font: 400 14px/1.4 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-search input:hover { border-color: #cbd5e1; } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.58 0.17 257); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.17 257 / 0.5); }

components.name: Object Library Item
components.description: A 44px insertion or selection row with compact icon, name, and dimension hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-object-item { min-height: 44px; width: 260px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #1e293b; text-align: left; transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-object-item:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-object-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(47 125 244 / 0.35); } .ds-object-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 9px; background: #fff; color: #315474; } .ds-object-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-object-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1; display: grid; gap: 1px; } .ds-object-copy strong { overflow: hidden; color: #1e293b; font: 500 14px/1.25 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-object-copy small { color: #64748b; font: 400 11px/1.35 "Geist Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-object-plus { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; color: #94a3b8; font: 400 18px/1 Geist, sans-serif; } .ds-object-item:hover .ds-object-plus { background: #e6efff; color: #1d64cf; }

components.name: Canvas Command Cluster
components.description: A compact white cluster for zoom, fit, grid, and other persistent canvas commands.
components.html: 100%
components.css: .ds-canvas-cluster { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #64748b; box-shadow: 0 5px 18px rgb(31 55 81 / 0.1); } .ds-canvas-cluster button { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 500 14px/1 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; transition: background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-canvas-cluster button:hover { background: #f1f5f9; color: #1e293b; } .ds-canvas-cluster button:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.58 0.17 257); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.17 257 / 0.5); } .ds-canvas-cluster output { min-width: 56px; text-align: center; font: 500 12px/1 "Geist Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-canvas-cluster svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }

components.name: Brand Rail
components.description: The dark structural anchor that connects product identity to the desktop object tray.
components.html: Room PlannerPrecise layouts, saved locally
components.css: .ds-brand-rail { width: 288px; height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 20px; background: #10233f; color: #fff; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 10px; background: #2f7df4; box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgb(21 96 208 / 0.3); } .ds-brand-mark svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-brand-rail > span:last-child { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-brand-rail strong { font: 600 14px/1.25 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-brand-rail small { color: #cbd5e1; font: 400 11px/1.3 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Floating Object Toolbar
components.description: The highest contextual tool layer for selected-object actions and exact dimensions.
components.html: Three-seat sofa
components.css: .ds-object-toolbar { width: 448px; max-width: calc(100% - 16px); padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: #1e293b; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgb(15 35 60 / 0.16); } .ds-toolbar-head { height: 32px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-toolbar-head strong { min-width: 0; flex: 1; padding-left: 4px; overflow: hidden; font: 600 12px/1.3 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-toolbar-head button { width: 28px; height: 28px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: transparent; color: #334155; } .ds-toolbar-head button:hover { background: #f1f5f9; } .ds-toolbar-head button:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.58 0.17 257); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.17 257 / 0.5); } .ds-toolbar-head .ds-delete { color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); } .ds-toolbar-fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 0.92fr; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid #f1f5f9; } .ds-toolbar-fields label { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 4px; color: #94a3b8; font: 600 10px/1 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-toolbar-fields label > span { position: relative; } .ds-toolbar-fields input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 27px 0 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 0.55rem; background: #f8fafc; color: #1e293b; font: 400 12px/1 "Geist Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-toolbar-fields input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.58 0.17 257); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.58 0.17 257 / 0.5); } .ds-toolbar-fields small { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: #64748b; font: 400 10px/1 Geist, Arial, sans-serif; pointer-events: none; }

narrative.overview:
Room Planner should feel like a precise drafting instrument made approachable for everyday spatial decisions. A dark navy brand rail and quiet white command header frame a pale object tray, while the blueprint canvas remains the dominant working surface rather than another card inside an app shell.

The visual language is restrained, technical, and direct: crisp labels, tabular measurements, solid controls, fine dividers, and cool functional blue reserved for interaction and selection. Depth is ambient and offset, never glassy or decorative; every surface should help users locate tools, trust dimensions, and return attention to the plan.
keyCharacteristics: Blueprint canvas as the visual and interaction focal point.
Dark navy brand anchor with pale neutral work surfaces.
Compact Geist interface text paired with Geist Mono measurements.
Solid white controls with restrained borders and ambient offset shadows.
Functional blue used for action, focus, and selection rather than decoration.
Desktop object tray that consolidates into a left-side mobile sheet.

rules.name: The Blueprint Restraint Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies action, focus, and selection; it does not wash entire panels or become ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Measurement Voice Rule
rules.body: Any value users compare spatially or numerically uses the mono face and tabular numerals; prose and action labels stay in the sans face.

rules.name: The Canvas First Rule
rules.body: Shell regions frame the work; they never compete with the blueprint canvas for area, contrast, or visual emphasis.

rules.name: The Ambient Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows explain canvas-layer elevation through soft navy-tinted offset; they never create glossy, glassy, or decorative cards.

rules.name: The Tool, Not Card Rule
rules.body: Group controls because they operate together; do not wrap routine content in rounded decorative containers.

dos: Do keep the blueprint canvas visually dominant and let shell surfaces recede around it.
Do use functional blue for interactive meaning: action, keyboard focus, active tools, and selection.
Do set dimensions, counts, zoom, and grid values in mono type with tabular numerals.
Do preserve 44px targets for commands and library rows exposed on mobile.
Do consolidate object browsing and secondary navigation into the left mobile sheet.
Do use solid white floating controls with cool borders and restrained navy-tinted offset shadows.
donts: Don't introduce glassmorphism, translucent decorative cards, or ornamental blur into the editor shell.
Don't turn routine controls or content groups into a collection of rounded cards.
Don't use accent blue as broad panel decoration or allow it to compete with the plan.
Don't style measurements in proportional type when users need to scan or compare them.
Don't promote a particular room shape, object arrangement, or toolbar coordinate into a reusable design-system rule.
Don't keep the desktop object tray persistently visible on narrow screens; use the established sheet treatment.
